digest.component_or_area: MCP and review-bot service initialization and auth composition
propositions: Startup deployment/static config must be captured once at service initialization and remain stable across ambient mutations; each operation receives a fresh non-secret operation snapshot
Inbound MCP bearer tokens must remain request-scoped transient context and never leak into startup bindings, operation snapshots, serialization, logs, caches, or child environments
Review-bot decision-bearing auth (Gerrit/GitHub credentials) must be validated at job acceptance before work begins, with no fallback to alternate principals
Partial or rejected Langfuse/OTLP telemetry setup must disable observability without altering the underlying operation result, while security/load-bearing auth remains fail-closed
Static binding changes are observed only after process restart/redeploy; native SDK-owned credential refresh behavior remains unchanged
The AWS review-bot production service and CI reconciler both demonstrated end-to-end success processing RP-04 S5 code with startup binding, decision auth, and runtime forwarding
